import { MeshBasicNodeMaterial } from 'three/webgpu';
import { uv, vec3, mix } from 'three/tsl';
import { gsap } from 'gsap';

export default function createNode(config, ctx) {
  const { Group, Mesh, PlaneGeometry } = ctx.THREE;

  const group = new Group();

  const disposables = [];
  const activeTweens = [];

  // Colors
  const rawInk = '#16161d';
  const rawPaper = '#e8ecf2';
  const rawAccent = '#ff2a38';
  const rawSurface = '#0b0b10';

  // Parse color constants to fractional RGB for TSL
  const uInk = vec3(0.086, 0.086, 0.114);      // #16161d
  const uSurface = vec3(0.043, 0.043, 0.063);  // #0b0b10
  const uAccent = vec3(1.0, 0.165, 0.22);      // #ff2a38

  // 1. Base Gradient card
  const cardGeometry = new PlaneGeometry(2.4, 1.5);
  disposables.push(cardGeometry);

  const cardMaterial = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0.95
  });
  disposables.push(cardMaterial);

  // High contrast engineered gradient
  const gradient = mix(
    uSurface,
    mix(uInk, uAccent, uv().x.mul(0.15)),
    uv().y
  );
  cardMaterial.colorNode = gradient;

  const cardMesh = new Mesh(cardGeometry, cardMaterial);
  group.add(cardMesh);

  // 2. Texture Graphic Layer
  const imageGeometry = new PlaneGeometry(2.3, 1.4);
  disposables.push(imageGeometry);

  const imageMaterial = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({
    transparent: true,
    opacity: 0,
    depthWrite: false
  });
  disposables.push(imageMaterial);

  const imageMesh = new Mesh(imageGeometry, imageMaterial);
  imageMesh.position.z = 0.005;
  group.add(imageMesh);

  const imageUrl = config.imageUrl || (config.intent?.visualSpec?.imageUrl);
  if (imageUrl) {
    ctx.textureLoader.loadTexture(imageUrl).then((texture) => {
      imageMaterial.map = texture;
      imageMaterial.needsUpdate = true;
      const t = gsap.to(imageMaterial, {
        opacity: 0.85,
        duration: 0.6,
        ease: 'power2.out'
      });
      activeTweens.push(t);
    }).catch((err) => {
      console.warn('Failed to load image texture:', err);
    });
  }

  // 3. UI Content / Typography (Verbatim mapping)
  const textItems = config.textContent ?? config.intent?.visualSpec?.textContent ?? [];
  const textString = textItems[0]?.text ?? "FEATURES 1";

  const textElement = ctx.fontAtlas.createText(textString.toUpperCase(), {
    fontSize: 0.14,
    color: rawPaper,
    align: 'center',
    letterSpacingPx: 3
  });

  if (textElement) {
    textElement.position.set(0, -0.38, 0.01);
    group.add(textElement);
  }

  // Subtle accent layout highlight line
  const accentLineGeo = new PlaneGeometry(0.35, 0.015);
  disposables.push(accentLineGeo);
  const accentLineMat = new MeshBasicNodeMaterial({ color: rawAccent });
  disposables.push(accentLineMat);
  const accentLine = new Mesh(accentLineGeo, accentLineMat);
  accentLine.position.set(0, -0.52, 0.01);
  group.add(accentLine);

  // 4. Subtle Presentation Entrance Transition
  group.scale.set(0.9, 0.9, 0.9);
  const entranceTween = gsap.to(group.scale, {
    x: 1.0,
    y: 1.0,
    z: 1.0,
    duration: 0.8,
    ease: 'power3.out'
  });
  activeTweens.push(entranceTween);

  // Clean-up checklist configuration safely attached
  group.userData = {
    cleanup() {
      activeTweens.forEach((t) => {
        if (t && typeof t.kill === 'function') {
          t.kill();
        }
      });
      disposables.forEach((resource) => {
        if (resource && typeof resource.dispose === 'function') {
          resource.dispose();
        }
      });
    }
  };

  return group;
}
